name: Jowls the Grey Tomcat
blurb: Jowls, a big round-cheeked grey tomcat with sleepy half-shut eyes and a thick ruff, sits as still as an old photo on the garden wall.

name: Sepia the Plush Grey Cat
blurb: Sepia, a heavy-set plush grey shorthair with wide jowls and faint ghost stripes on his cheeks, naps on the potting-shed shelf.

name: Pestle the Shelf Cat
blurb: Pestle, a stocky slate-grey tomcat with a broad face and a deep ruffled chest, keeps watch over the stone mortars in the greenhouse.
